seo.title: On Every Pitch We Are Argentina
seo.description: A documentary by 83s about football, identity and belonging far from home. The Argentine community in Barcelona and its passion for the national team.

nav.title: On every pitch we are Argentina

hero.title_alt: En todas las canchas somos Argentina (On every pitch we are Argentina)
hero.tagline: Football, identity and belonging far from home.
hero.image_alt: Argentine fans cheering with flags and drums

director.label: The director's vision
director.quote: A journey to Argentina that is also lived in Barcelona.
director.body: This documentary was born from meeting a community that keeps alive its passion for the national team, its stories and its culture. A portrait of identity, friendship, migration and what it means to be Argentine anywhere in the world.
director.name: Gonzalo Saavedra
director.image_alt: Gonzalo Saavedra seated in front of rows of yellow seats

photos.label: Photo essay by
photos.name: Lucas Urenda
photos.body: A photographic exhibition about the community, its gatherings, its people and the passion that unites them far from home.
images: Supporters' drums reading Siempre vamos a estar
Fan seen from behind wearing Messi's number 10 shirt

filial.label: The people who made this story possible
filial.name: Diego Justo
filial.quote: The Filial is much more than a group of fans. It's a family, a meeting place, a support network and a piece of Argentina in Barcelona.
filial.body: Diego Justo, founder and leading figure of Filial Argentina, tells how the idea for this project was born, the work of the community and what it means to keep the albiceleste passion alive from afar.
filial.image_alt: Diego Justo during the interview, wearing the national team shirt

sponsors.body: Partners who believed in this story and supported the project from the very beginning.
